purpose: Core-domain route, fixture, smoke, expected-result, failure and privacy acceptance.

core_domains.route_prompt: 新建一个临床研究项目
core_domains.smoke: create project in isolated temporary root and verify project.yaml/status.yaml
core_domains.privacy_gate: restricted by default; raw_data immutable; PHI upload blocked

core_domains.smoke: run qpcr_qc review with complete Ct values and duplicate technical-replicate negative case
core_domains.failure_case: missing Ct, invalid range, duplicate technical replicate

core_domains.expected_smoke: PASS for control-plane scaffold; evidence synthesis requires live sources
core_domains.failure_case: no protocol or no traceable source record
core_domains.privacy_gate: public evidence only unless explicitly classified otherwise

core_domains.smoke: verify route and domain contract; no fabricated summary statistics
core_domains.expected_smoke: PASS route/contract; BLOCKED without real exposure/outcome inputs
core_domains.failure_case: missing GWAS IDs, allele harmonization or LD evidence
core_domains.privacy_gate: public summary statistics preferred; restricted individual-level data cannot upload

core_domains.smoke: verify accession-oriented route, runtime gate and metadata/QC contract
core_domains.expected_smoke: PASS route/contract; BLOCKED until real accession and suitable matrix are supplied
core_domains.failure_case: unresolved sample annotation or unavailable raw/count input
core_domains.privacy_gate: public dataset provenance required; no restricted upload

core_domains.smoke: verify isolated Scanpy/R runtimes, real scDblFinder partitions, h5ad, UMAP, marker and donor-pseudobulk outputs
core_domains.expected_smoke: PASS only when the real-data run manifest and reproduce check verify
core_domains.failure_case: missing scDblFinder, cell-as-replicate inference or incomplete provenance
core_domains.privacy_gate: raw data immutable; donor/library IDs remain restricted local metadata
